subject: Acme Corp - Renewal & Expansion Recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Corp - Renewal & Expansion Recap

Hi Jane — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our renewal/expansion call and next steps so we’re aligned.

Summary of discussion:
- Current usage: ~1.8M tokens/day across customer-facing chat and internal search workflows.
- Pain points: latency spikes during peak hours (~600–800ms), cost sensitivity on embedding-heavy search jobs, and the need for stricter data residency for the new EU product launch.
- Goals: reduce 99th pct latency to <350ms for chat, cut embedding unit cost by ~25% through batching/quantization, and pilot Private VPC for EU data by EoQ4.

Proposal / expansion path we discussed:
1) Dedicated reserved capacity (3x gpus) for chat to hit latency SLOs; initial 6-month commit to stabilize performance.
2) Embeddings optimization: quantization + caching for search workloads — expected 20–30% unit cost reduction.
3) Private deployment evaluation for EU workload with a pilot in October (customer-managed VPC + HSM key integration).

Attachments I’ve included: acme_usage_q3.csv (usage breakdown) and a draft SOW outline (acme_statement_of_work_v2.pdf) to give you a sense of timeline & milestones.

Proposed next steps:
- Jane: confirm procurement timeline and any must-have contract terms by Fri 10/1.
- Redwood: provide a 6-month pricing estimate for Dedicated + expansion pricing for embeddings by 10/4.
- Ops/Eng sync: technical kickoff with Ben + Rishi the week of 10/11 for the Private pilot.

If that matches your notes, I’ll send a one-page version for procurement and loop in our legal to prep a draft SOW.

Thanks — and great conversation today.

— Marissa

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Usage numbers look right; Q3 spiked around mid-August as expected.
- Primary priority is the chat latency (our NPS falls when response times exceed ~500ms).
- For procurement: our legal team needs the following addressed in the SOW: data residency clause for EU pilot, standard indemnity language, and an SLA with uptime/latency targets for Dedicated.

Procurement timeline: we’re aiming to have a PO issued by 10/20, but that depends on how quickly we can align the SOW. If you can share a one-page commercial summary and the draft SOW this week, I’ll route to legal.

Also, wanted to flag an internal ask: we may want a short technical health check from Ben to validate integration effort for the Private pilot.

Best,

Looping in a short technical note for Jane and the Acme eng team:

- For the Private pilot we recommend starting with a small infra shim (1 GPU + autoscaling policy) to validate KV cache warmup and latency under production prefixes before moving to the full 3 GPU Dedicated fleet. This reduces risk and gives real telemetry for the SLA work.
- We’ll prepare a short checklist for required network/IP ranges and KMS/HSM requirements ahead of the 10/11 kickoff.

I’m available 10/11–10/15 for the kickoff; Rishi and I will coordinate the technical agenda.
